issues: Table shows only 3 employees (Test Google OAuth User, Google Test Customer, Rahul Verma) while HR dashboard says 25 total. Appears the tab filters to only users with attendance rows this month; CSV export itself contains fuller data, so not blocking, but a text like 'Showing employees with attendance activity this month' would clarify.

critical_code_review_comments: operator_erp_routes.complete_maintenance sets aircraft.last_maintenance_hours = total_flight_hours without protecting against completing an already-completed maintenance (idempotency). Not blocking (POST idempotent by design here) but consider returning 409 if status already == 'completed'.
flight_record create endpoint uses datetime.utcnow().isoformat() (naive); other newer endpoints use timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc). Minor consistency nit.
